content.short: Platypus Finance is a specialized stableswap AMM on Avalanche designed for high capital efficiency and low slippage.
content.description:
Platypus Finance is a leading decentralized liquidity protocol built natively on the Avalanche blockchain, specifically engineered for high-performance stablecoin swaps. The platform features an innovative single-sided liquidity provision model, which allows users to deposit only one type of asset into a pool while maintaining high capital efficiency and minimal slippage. This design significantly simplifies the experience for liquidity providers and reduces the friction typically associated with traditional AMM structures.

By leveraging Avalanche's high speed and low latency, Platypus delivers a seamless and highly responsive trading environment for major stablecoins. The protocol is governed by the PTP token and focuses on professional-grade transparency and on-chain execution. As a core infrastructure component of the Avalanche DeFi landscape, Platypus Finance is dedicated to providing the essential liquidity tools needed for participants to build and manage sophisticated decentralized portfolios with institutional-grade precision.
